items.title: Vistra Sinks 16% in a Week to a New 52-Week Low. Is the Texas Selloff Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra fell 16% in a week to a new 52-week low, with Vertiv, after Texas elected a governor who promised to halt new data centers. Vistra had hedged about 94% of its expected 2027 output as of early August, and most of its new gas plants are in PJM, where a peer sees strong demand.

items.title: Vistra (VST) Could Be 8% Undervalued On Dividend Approval
items.summary: Vistra (VST) is back in focus after its board approved dividends on both preferred and common shares, drawing new attention to how its income policies compare with the recent share price pullback. That dividend decision comes after a sharp reset in sentiment. Vistra’s share price has fallen 13.8% in the past day and is down 27.2% year to date. However, the 5-year total shareholder return is approximately 6x, so the recent weakness represents a break in what had been powerful momentum. Seize...

items.title: Steve Weiss Says the Midterms Just Put a Lid on AI Spending. Here’s Who Could Get Hurt
items.summary: Chipmakers barely flinched when Democrats swept the midterms, but two stocks tied to AI data centers got hammered. A Texas permit freeze could explain the split, and it may reach your 401(k) even if you never bought an AI stock.

items.title: The Election Flipped Congress. It Also Flipped the Market.
items.summary: With the midterms in the review mirror, Wall Street let out a sigh of relief and sent stocks surging.

items.title: VST, CEG Stocks Drop As Election Outcome Hits Merchant Power Generators
items.summary: Incoming Texas governor Gina Hinojosa has advocated an immediate pause on new data-center construction, an end to related tax incentives, and stronger local controls over water and electricity use.

items.title: Vistra plunges 13.5% as Texas election rattles AI power trade, KeyBanc downgrades
items.summary: Investing.com -- Vistra shares plunged 13.5% on Wednesday after a sweeping Democratic victory in the US midterm elections raised concerns about the future of data-center development in Texas, prompting KeyBanc to downgrade the electricity generator.

items.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 8%, Vistra Down 14% as Democrats’ Midterm Sweep Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 8% this morning after Democrats won Congress, in a selloff that also hit Vistra, GE Vernova and CoreWeave. Its signed deals with Alphabet’s Google and Amazon still stand, so the risk is in future contracts.

items.title: GE Vernova Sinks 10%, Vistra Down 12% as Democrats Win Congress: “Incrementally More Negative Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova fell 10% today, with Vistra and Constellation Energy, after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Only about 20% of GE Vernova’s contracted gas turbine capacity serves data centers.
